verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch developer platform documents a sandbox environment for sending test data. Production keys are issued only after passing a demo, which keeps sandbox testing separate from production. Both points are confirmed by the developer portal and the supplementary description of the Case Status API. Missing for 10: in-depth sandbox documentation (test-data fixtures, parity with production behavior, coverage of both the Case Status and FOIA APIs) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as described.
